text.p: Fraser-AMMB Research called a buy on Singapore Technologies Shipbuilding & Engineering Ltd (ST Shipbuilding) on Thursday.

In its daily review, the research house said the share price had fallen to four-year lows and was now trading within strong support between Singapore $1.60 and S$1.90 with downside risk limited to S$1.50.
At midday on Thursday, the local tranche was bid/asked at S$1.59/1.60 while the foreign tranche was around S$1.92.

"Its undemanding price-earnings multiples which are only about half the market P/E for 1997 are expected to trend down further from 1999. This coupled with excellent 2.1 times (local) and 1.7 times (foreign) growth to P/E ratio from 1996 to year 2000 makes ST Shipbuilding an excellent buy," Fraser-AMMB said.
It said ST Shipbuilding's earnings up to 2001 will be strongly underpinned by a healthy orderbook totalling S$710 million todate.
It also has a higher-than-expected contract to build four landing ship tanks estimated over S$500 million in total, which should boost earnings from 1999 to 2001.
